verdict.rationale: Loops is an email-sending platform, so per-send deliverability monitoring is a fair question. The evidence pack contains no documentation of bounce, complaint, or blocklist reporting per send, and nothing on alerting or guidance when deliverability degrades. The only nearby items are a vaguely described 'Guardian checks on an email message' API endpoint and an agent skill for 'email sending best practices', and neither shows post-send signals or remediation guidance.
